description: This file defines the SelfEvaluationController class, which handles the performance review self-evaluation process within the Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for preparing data for rendering and permission checks based on employee review data.

classes.name: SelfEvaluationController
classes.description: Controller for handling self-evaluation performance reviews, extending AdminEvaluationController, utilizing traits for performance review services and user role management.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering by fetching the performance review based on ID from the request and setting it to the component; throws exception if ID is missing.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has permission to perform the action based on the performance review data and employee status.
